title: End-to-end introduction, in a browser
notes: Scores the run `e2e/bench-connect-journey.spec.ts` performed: propose → student approves at 375 px → instructor sends → employer opens the emailed link, books a time, and hires → a verified Application and a placement queue item exist. The spec writes reports/benchmarks/raw/connect-journey.json and this scorer reads it, so the browser run and the measurement are separable — the runner does not have to own Playwright. `student_taps` counts only what the STUDENT does; the instructor's and the employer's steps are real work by other people and are not what the design's 12-tap floor is about. `elapsed_ms` is informational and includes database polling, so it is a trend line, not a latency number. Reports `skipped` when the spec has not run.
